title: Les maisons du bord de l'eau (Waterfront Houses)

said.q: Claude Pissarro” (lower left) Oil on canvas In this composition, French artist H. Claude Pissaro renders his peaceful scene in rich three-dimensional depth. Entitled Les maisons du bord de l'eau, this artwork displays a serene cluster of houses nestled in lush foliage, overlooking a tranquil body of water.
